caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a person standing on a decorative pedestal. The figure is dressed in a long, red garment that reaches to the ankles, with slits on either side exposing the lower legs. Draped over the left shoulder and falling around the upper body is a blue sash or cloak. The person has shoulder-length dark hair and is barefoot. The left arm is missing below the elbow, and the right arm is missing at the shoulder, consistent with the appearance of an ancient or damaged statue. The pedestal is light gray with blue and brown accent panels and features a multi-tiered base. The background is plain and unadorned, with the main focus placed solely on the statue and its base. The artist's signature, "Carl Strehlau," is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Wooden Figure
